Account database APIs, error codes, and account meta helpers for Solana records.

# Purpose
Defines the account manager interface for the Solana runtime account database. It declares error codes, size limits, and inline helper functions for `fd_account_meta_t`, including initialization, existence checks, data access, and record size calculation. It also provides the [`fd_funk_acc_key`](<#fd_funk_acc_key>) helper to map a public key to a funk record key, and declares APIs to read account metadata from funk and to convert `fd_acc_mgr` error codes into text.
# Function Declarations (Public API)

---
- `fd_funk_get_acc_meta_readonly`
- `fd_acc_mgr_strerror`
